title: Netflix Unveils the Trailer for Swedish Psychological Thriller 'A Couple of Lies'
summary: A Couple of Lies, starring Emma Appleton, Fares Fares, Frida Gustavsson and Jakob Oftebro, premieres on Netflix on October 30.
body_markdown:
Every lie leaves a trace. Every secret has a price


Download images


[here](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/767bda62-7575-4495-8562-6bbd6031fc52)


A Couple of Lies,


starring Emma Appleton, Fares Fares, Frida Gustavsson and Jakob Oftebro, premieres on Netflix on October 30.


Based on the novel by the same name by best‑selling crime author Stefan Ahnhem, the psychological thriller series follows two couples whose dream holiday home swap spirals into something far more dangerous, leaving them unsure whether they can even trust the person they love.


ABOUT BYTET


Synopsis:


Helene (Frida Gustavsson) and Carl (Fares Fares) trade their home in Stockholm's archipelago for a sun-drenched villa in Sicily, swapping lives for some weeks with Scarlett (Emma Appleton) and Adam (Jakob Oftebro); a couple they’ve never met. But as they settle into each other’s houses, unsettling details begin to surface. As secrets emerge and hidden betrayals come to light, what started


as a picture‑perfect escape slowly warps into a twisted game of surveillance, manipulation and mistrust.
